title: No Questions Asked
cn: 第 7 集 · 毋庸置疑
novel:
Daphne sent a [[troubling|trouble]] text message to Lily from Marshall's phone. The message [[revealed|reveal]] that Marshall had taken a job as a judge without telling Lily. Marshall [[panicked|panic]] when he found out what Daphne had done.

He immediately called his friends and asked them to [[delete|delete]] the message before Lily could read it. He used the No Questions Asked rule, which meant they had to do what he said without asking why. This rule had been [[created|create]] by Barney years ago.

Ted was the first to receive the request. He was confused but agreed to follow the rule. He tried to [[sneak|sneak]] into Lily's room and [[hide|hide]] her phone. However, Lily [[noticed|notice]] him and became [[suspicious|suspicious]].

Robin and Barney also received the No Questions Asked requests. They each tried different [[clever|clever]] ways to get rid of the message. Robin [[pretended|pretend]] she needed Lily's help in the kitchen, while Barney created a [[distraction|distraction]] by starting a fight with a hotel guest.

The situation became more [[chaotic|chaotic]] as everyone tried to complete their missions. Marshall was [[desperate|desperate]] to keep his secret. He knew Lily would be furious if she found out he had accepted the judge position without discussing it with her first.

In the end, Lily [[discovered|discover]] the truth anyway. She was not angry about the job itself, but she was upset that Marshall had tried to [[deceive|deceive]] her. She told him that [[honesty|honesty]] was the most important thing in their marriage. Marshall [[apologized|apologize]] and promised to always be truthful with her.

panic.en: She panicked when she saw the fire.

delete.en: He deleted the email by mistake.

sneak.en: He sneaked out of the house.

hide.en: She hid the cookies from the kids.

suspicious.en: She was suspicious of his behavior.
